config.corpus: all 1,814,924 pinned ESCI locale-product titles; metadata only
config.order: locale es, jp, us; ascending product_id within each locale
config.shard_boundaries: never mix locales; final shard of each locale may be shorter
config.encoding: unchanged pilot encoder, model revision, NFKC, passage prefix, float32, eager attention, batch size 32, max_length 128, masked mean and L2 normalization; 4 CPU threads; MPS if available, otherwise explicit CPU; unsupported-operator fallback disabled
config.storage: one little-endian row-major float32 payload, row-aligned locale/product-ID JSONL and atomic checkpoint manifest per shard; one writer lock for the export
config.resume: verify contract, source data, identities, payload checksums and norms; skip committed shards; reject corrupt commits and changed contracts; replace only uncommitted orphans
config.validation: exact per-locale counts and strict key ordering; shape, finite values, unit norm within 1e-5; compare all 3,072 pilot identities to their reference vectors with max absolute difference <=1e-5 and minimum cosine >=0.99999
config.restart_experiment: controlled stop after two committed shards, then resume without re-encoding those 8,192 titles; preserve session measurements and completed replay artifacts
config.measurement: record per-locale encode time, main wall time across actual sessions, load/warmup/validation/checkpoint work, kernel-reported process max RSS, observed MPS allocations, truncation and actual disk bytes; do not sum overlapping unified-memory readings
config.scope: embedding export only; no dense index, retrieval-quality evaluation, fusion, training, query/judgment partition access or official test exposure

execution.note: Wall time includes source/model/reference checks, metadata scan/sort, encoding, validation, persistence and per-session setup; excludes between-invocation downtime, interpreter bootstrap and final report serialization. MPS observations are not true GPU peaks or additive to RSS; RSS is process, not whole host.

storage.note: File bytes/blocks exclude directory metadata, original catalog, model cache and public report; not a measurement of whole-filesystem physical flash use.

limits: One full-catalog title export with fixed 128-token truncation; no ANN index, retrieval relevance, fusion, training or serving capacity measured. Full-run restart was a controlled stop; prior SIGKILL evidence belongs to the pilot.
